title: Mintu Ka Homework Hack! 🧠❌
visual_style: Bright, vibrant 2D cartoon animation style with exaggerated funny expressions, dramatic sound effects, and fast-paced editing. Consistent original cartoon universe.

characters.name: Mintu
characters.appearance: Short messy black hair, wheatish skin tone, wide expressive eyes, normal body proportions.
characters.clothing: Red t-shirt with a star logo, blue shorts, and red sneakers.
characters.personality: Super clever, mischievous, always finding lazy shortcuts.

characters.name: Mummy
characters.appearance: Long black hair tied in a neat ponytail, warm wheatish skin tone, stern yet caring facial features.
characters.clothing: Teal green cotton saree with a yellow border.
characters.personality: Ninja-level observant, strict, loving, with superpower hearing.

characters.name: Tommy
characters.appearance: Fluffy brown and white puppy with floppy ears and a wagging tail.
characters.clothing: No clothing, wearing a simple red collar.

scenes.narration: Bro, Mintu ne aisi ninja technique lagayi ki homework khud-b-khud gayab ho jaye! But wait... mom ka radar on hai!
scenes.dialogue: Arre yaar! Ye math ka homework dekh ke na mujhe chakkar aa raha hai. Full torture hai ye!
scenes.action: Mintu is looking at a heavy math notebook with a horror face. Zoom in on his expressions.
scenes.background: Colorful Indian children's bedroom with study table, scattered books, and a colorful bookshelf.
scenes.camera: Close-up shot, dramatic zoom in on Mintu's face.
scenes.visual_description: Mintu, a 10-year-old boy with short messy black hair, wheatish skin, wearing a red t-shirt with a star logo and blue shorts, staring in horror at a thick math notebook on his study table.

Bright vibrant 2D cartoon animation style, expressive funny cartoon eyes, indoor bedroom background, warm lighting.

scenes.narration: Mintu tries his ultimate lazy physics hack to absorb knowledge without opening a single page.
scenes.dialogue: Idea! Agar main is book pe dhyan se so jaunga, toh saare formulas mere dimaag mein Bluetooth se transfer ho jayenge!
scenes.action: Mintu puts his physics book on his head, closing his eyes tightly.
scenes.background: Same colorful Indian children's bedroom and study table.
scenes.visual_description: Mintu, wearing his red t-shirt and blue shorts, balances a thick physics book on top of his messy black hair, eyes squeezed shut with a funny smart-aleck smile.

Bright vibrant 2D cartoon animation style, indoor bedroom background, clear lighting.

scenes.narration: Even pets know when math is a disaster zone!
scenes.dialogue: Dekha Tommy? Doggy ne bhi bol diya—Math is dangerous! Ab toh pakka exemption milni chahiye.
scenes.action: Mintu's pet dog sniffs the math book and sneezes on it. Mintu opens one eye, smiling.
scenes.background: Study room floor next to the study table.
scenes.camera: Low angle shot, focusing on Mintu and his puppy.
scenes.visual_description: Mintu, a 10-year-old boy with short messy black hair, red t-shirt, and blue shorts, looks down with one eye open while Tommy, a fluffy brown-and-white puppy, sneezes near the math book on the floor.
scenes.image_prompt: Low angle vertical 9:16 composition of Mintu, a 10-year-old Indian boy with short messy black hair, wheatish skin, wearing a red t-shirt and blue shorts, sitting on the floor with one eye open and a triumphant smile, looking at a fluffy brown-and-white puppy named Tommy sneezing on a math book. Bright vibrant 2D cartoon animation style, indoor room background, bright lighting.

scenes.narration: Mission undercover gamer is successfully underway, or so he thinks.
scenes.dialogue: Hehe, Mummy ko kya pata! Main toh undercover agent banke mission complete kar raha hoon.
scenes.action: Mintu hides under the blanket with a flashlight, playing a game on his phone instead of studying.
scenes.background: A cozy bed with a colorful blanket tent glowing from the inside.
scenes.camera: Medium shot focusing on the glowing blanket tent.
scenes.visual_description: Mintu, a 10-year-old boy with short messy black hair and red t-shirt, hiding under a colorful blanket on his bed, holding a glowing smartphone and grinning mischievously in the dark.

scenes.narration: And then... disaster strikes with zero warning sound!
scenes.dialogue: Wait... ye kya twist ho gaya?! Mummy, aap yahan teleport kaise ho gayi?!
scenes.action: Suddenly, the blanket is pulled away with lightning speed. Mummy is standing with hands on her hips, holding a wooden spoon.
scenes.background: The children's bedroom, wide view of the bed.
scenes.camera: Dynamic wide shot, quick zoom out effect.
scenes.visual_description: Mintu, looking terrified with hair standing on end in his red t-shirt, sitting on the bed as Mummy—a 35-year-old woman with a neat ponytail wearing a teal green saree—stands sternly with hands on her hips holding a wooden spoon.

ending_lesson: Shortcut ka chakkar, padega bhaari! Homework time pe khatam karo, warna Mummy ki entry fix hai! 😉
